_source: Blender EEVEE demo 'Ember Forest' by Mike Pan, CC-BY — https://mirror.blender.org/demo/eevee/ember_forest/forest.blend
_note: Small misty clearing with one gnarled dead tree (7 m). Character stands just in front of the trunk; cameras look along world +X so the tree crowns the frame. Ground mesh is only ~17x13 m, so wide shots see the mist beyond its edge — that is the intended look.
